user.title: UNI PRO Modbus bridge
user.description: Connect to the Modbus TCP bridge (e.g. an ESP32 RS485-to-TCP gateway) wired to your UNI2/UNI3 PRO controller.

circuits.title: Heating circuits
circuits.description: Select the heating circuits (CO1-CO7) this {model} actually uses, and whether to add DHW / Circulation.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge or get a response from the controller. Check the IP/port and that the RS485 wiring and Slave ID are correct.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.remote_enabled: Off by default. When on, the current register values are sent to the endpoint below at the chosen interval. Nothing is sent unless you enable this and fill in a URL and key.
data_description.remote_url: The HTTPS address your service provider gave you, e.g. https://uni-api.example.com/ingest.php
data_description.remote_key: The per-site access key your service provider gave you.

error.remote_incomplete: To enable remote monitoring, both the endpoint URL and the access key are required.
error.remote_not_https: The remote endpoint must start with https:// so measurements are sent encrypted.

set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule
set_schedule.description: Write a weekly on/off schedule (per hour) to a heating circuit, the DHW circuit or the circulation circuit. Only the days you provide are changed; omitted days keep their current schedule on the device.

entry_id.name: Integration instance
entry_id.description: Which UNI PRO Modbus instance to target. Optional if only one is configured.

days.name: Days
days.description: Mapping of weekday to the hours that should be ON. Each day's value is a list of hour numbers (0-23), or the shortcut "all" or "none". Weekdays not listed are left unchanged.
